scripts.infra:up: test -f .env || { echo 'No .env in the repository root: run cp .env.example .env first.' >&2; exit 1; }; docker compose up -d --wait --wait-timeout 120 postgres redis minio mailpit && docker compose run --rm minio-init
scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && node packages/config/bin/run-task.js dev BE-01,FE-01
scripts.contracts: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml config -q && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml -f infra/docker/compose.override.yml config -q && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml -f infra/docker/compose.ci.yml config -q && pnpm --filter @jobflow/shared tokens:check
scripts.ci:local: pnpm format:check && pnpm dup && turbo run lint typecheck && turbo run test && pnpm test:int && pnpm contracts && docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile --target prod -t jobflow-api:local . && docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile --target prod -t jobflow-web:local . && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
